game.stash_n_stack_body: Above each reel is a Stash with Multipliers starting at x1. When any [[Wicked Grin]] symbol expands, all Coin values on that reel are multiplied by the Multiplier in the Stash! Landing additional expanding [[FS]] symbols during the bonus awards extra free spins.
game.coin_craze_body: When any [[Wicked Grin]] symbol expands, all Coin values on that reel are saved in the Coin Collector until the end of the bonus. Multipliers will first affect the Coin values, then multiply the saved value in the Coin Collector! Landing additional expanding [[FS]] symbols during the bonus awards extra free spins.
game.hes_wicked_body: [[Wicked Grin]] symbols expand and turns all symbols on that reel into Coins.
game.curtain_call_body: Two wicked bonuses packed with lots of Coins and Multipliers!
game.pennies_add_up_body: [[Hacksaw]] presents a max win of [[:maximumWinMultiplier]] times your bet!

external.about_desc_3: Step into the world of black and white, beneath the wicked grin lie coins aplenty. Just remember, Boney Bill has a few tricks up his sleeve. Come along for the max win of [[:maximumWinMultiplier]] times your bet in this 5-reel, 5-row game with All-Scatter wins. The max win is achievable in all game modes!
external.expanding_desc: When a [[Wicked Grin]] or Epic [[Wicked Grin]] symbol is located on the bottom row, it will expand after all wins are handled. Expanded [[Wicked Grin]] and Epic [[Wicked Grin]] symbols will transform all symbols on that reel into Coins or a Multiplier.
external.coins_desc: All Coins are paid as a multiple of your bet.
external.bronze_coin_values: Bronze Coins have the following starting values: [[1x, 2x, 3x, 4x]]
external.silver_coin_values: Silver Coins have the following starting values: [[5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x]]
external.gold_coin_values: Gold Coins have the following starting values: [[10x, 20x, 30x, 40x, 50x]]
external.diamond_coin_values: Diamond Coins have the following starting values: [[100x, 150x, 250x, 500x]]
external.multiplier_values: Multipliers have the following values: [[x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20]]
external.multiplier_desc: When a Multiplier is revealed, it will add a Multiplier value to all Coins above it and to Coins on the adjacent reels on rows above the Multiplier. If more than one Multiplier is revealed, they will add their values to the Coins one at a time from left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Multipliers cannot appear on the top row.
external.epic_spread_desc: Expanded Epic [[Wicked Grin]] symbols trigger any type of [[Wicked Grin]] symbols on the grid to expand from the position they are in.
external.epic_spread_desc_2: Only one type of [[Wicked Grin]] symbol can land on a reel at a time.
external.fs_symbols_desc: When at least 1 [[FS]] or Super [[FS]] [[scatter]] symbol is located on the bottom row, each [[FS]] symbol expands across the entire reel it lands on after all wins have been awarded. Every position the [[FS]] and Super [[FS]] symbol covers represents a certain number of free spins. The total number of free spins awarded for the bonus is determined by adding up all the numbers on positions covered by each [[FS]] or Super [[FS]] symbol. [[FS]] and Super [[FS]] symbols can have the following values: [[1, 2, 3]].
external.fs_symbols_desc_2: [[FS]] and Super [[FS]] cannot be on the grid at the same time. There can be a maximum of 2 [[FS]] and Super [[FS]] symbols on the grid at the same time.
external.stash_n_stack_desc_1: Activate this bonus with 5-30 free spins by landing at least 1 expanding [[FS]] [[scatter]] symbol during the base game.
external.stash_n_stack_desc_2: This bonus game keeps the base game’s mechanics. In addition, above each reel is a Stash with Multipliers starting at x1. When [[Wicked Grin]] symbols expand, all Coin values on that reel are multiplied by the Multiplier in the Stash. That Stash Multiplier will then increase by 1 for the next free spin.
external.stash_n_stack_desc_3: Landing additional expanding [[FS]] symbols in the bonus awards extra free spins. Each expanding [[FS]] symbol awards at least 5 free spins and max 15 free spins. The total additional free spins awarded can be between 5-30.
external.coin_craze_desc_1: Activate this bonus with 5-30 free spins by landing at least 1 expanding Super [[FS]] [[scatter]] symbol during the base game.
external.coin_craze_desc_2: This bonus game keeps the base game’s mechanics. In addition, above each reel is a Coin Collector which starts at 1. When any [[Wicked Grin]] symbol expands, all Coin values on that reel are saved in the Coin Collector until the end of the bonus. When Multipliers are revealed during an expansion, the Multiplier affects the Coin values and multiplies the saved value in the Coin Collector on that reel and on the adjacent reels. At the end of the bonus, all Coin Collector values are added together and multiplied by the bet amount to determine the final awarded win.
external.coin_craze_desc_3: Landing additional expanding Super [[FS]] symbols in the bonus awards extra free spins. Each expanding Super [[FS]] symbol awards at least 5 free spins and max 15 free spins. The total additional free spins awarded can be between 5-30.
external.special_symbols_desc: [[FS]] and any type of [[Wicked Grin]] symbols cannot land on the grid at the same time.
external.bonushunt_featurespins_desc: Each spin is 5 times more likely to trigger a bonus game!
external.grinny_featurespins_desc: Each spin guarantees that at least 1 type of [[Wicked Grin]] symbol lands!
external.stash_n_stack_desc: At least 5 free spins with a Stash above each reel that multiplies Coin values on that reel!
external.coin_craze_desc: At least 5 free spins with a Coin Collector that saves all Coin values until the end!
external.winways_body_allscatter: Land 6 or more symbols of the same kind anywhere on the grid to get a winning combination.
external.mod_feature_gameinfo_desc: The [[RTP]] when buying [[:bonus]] is [[:featurertp]]%. For full information about this feature, see the section above. [[FS]] symbols cannot land in this game mode.
external.maxwingermany_body: Maximum win: [[:maximumWinMultiplier]] times the total stake. Probability of getting the maximum win: 1:[[:oddsofmaxwin]]. The maximum win occurs when [[5]] Epic Wicked Grin or Wicked Grin symbols land at the bottom of each reel, activating and transforming all symbols above into Coins, with a combined multiplier value of [[:maximumWinMultiplier]]x that is paid as a multiple of the bet. The maximum win is the sum of all winning combinations when the reels are stationary, taking into account further winning opportunities such as bonus rounds and free spins. The maximum win can be achieved in the base game but is only possible with a lower probability, if bonus rounds are excluded.
